name: Human Expenditure Program
source:
Harvey Harvington is yours. You decide how he eats, how he lives, how he feels. The Program pays you for every moment of care. Just hope he never recalls what you’ve done.

[From [url=https://shroomychrist-studios.itch.io/human-expenditure-program]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
哈维·哈文顿是你的。你决定他如何饮食、如何生活、如何感受。该计划为你每时每刻的护理提供报酬。只是希望他永远不会记得你做过什么。

[来自[url=https://shroomychrist-studios.itch.io/human-expenditure-program]Itch.io[/url]]
